design.studio_url_comment: null: every capture serves the studio page bundled with the plugin. A URL (http://localhost:8081) captures from a running console instead, for working on the page itself
design._prices: estimates, checked on fal 2026-09-13: nano-banana-2/edit 0.08 USD per image, 1.5x at 2K; wan-22-vace depth 0.10 USD per second at 720p, billed at 16 fps

social.comment: One entry per platform. adapter is a module in plugins/dapilot/scripts/social/ or in DAPILOT_SOCIAL_ADAPTER_DIR; account names the session file under $DAPILOT_STORE_DIR/social/sessions/<platform>/.

instagram.comment: 2026-09-23: Meta answered 'API access blocked' two days after the first token; Instagram posts through CloakBrowser (instagram_web in DAPILOT_SOCIAL_ADAPTER_DIR) once that adapter exists. Set enabled true then. instagram_api stays in the plugin as the option for an app Meta leaves alone.

publish.comment: mode: live creates the Etsy listing when a price is approved; sandbox runs every stage but never touches Etsy or a social platform (the Settings tab of /dapilot:config switches it; a store without the key is live). auto_activate and auto_post: what the approval of a sale price sets off in live mode; false hands that step back to a person in the console.
